verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet-operations platform. Simulating robots before touching hardware is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence only covers agent install, telemetry, teleoperation, analytics and orchestration. The ThreeJS toolkit for custom 3D visualizations is a building block for visualization, not a physics or sensor simulator, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can simulate my robot and its environment with realistic physics and sensor models before touching hardware
